jobs.title: Business Product Owner | Full Time (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Who Are We ? 
 🚧 Picture logistics that run like clockwork –– fast, smart, and seamless. 
 Autonomous logistics does not start with self-driving trucks. It starts with CONROO.
 At CONROO, we are building an intelligent infrastructure that drives terminals and depots towards autonomy by connecting truck drivers, terminals, and depots through continuous data flows. We replace manual and paper-based processes with real-time, data-driven workflows, turning chaos into connected systems and making truck handling fully digital.
 Every step we automate today lays the foundation for terminals and depots to operate autonomously tomorrow.
 We are CONROO and we are driving logistics to autonomy. 
 💼 About This Role 
 We are looking for a Business Product Owner to join our team and act as a mini-CEO for one of our key markets, taking full ownership of its performance and growth. You will play a crucial role in establishing and maintaining our products' market leadership, driving product expansion, and enhancing operational efficiency.
 🎖️What success looks like 
 In your first month 
 You understand our product, customers, and operational landscape; how value is created, delivered, and scaled and start identifying opportunities for improvement.

 You establish strong working relationships with the Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success teams.

 By 3 months 
 Alongside our Product Owner, you contribute to defining a clear product vision and strategy, grounded in customer needs and market realities.

 You analyse product workflows and cost structures to improve efficiency and reduce time-to-market without sacrificing product quality.

 You coordinate cross-functional initiatives with Engineering, Sales, and Marketing to ensure efficient and well-executed go-lives.

 You become the main point of contact for our customers and engage directly with them, turning feedback into clear, actionable insights.

 By 6 months 
 You proactively drive product and operational improvements that measurably impact efficiency, cost, and customer satisfaction.

 You influence roadmap decisions through market research, competitive analysis, and customer data.

 You streamline customer support and success processes to improve response times and long-term customer health.

 You’re trusted as a key partner across teams – shaping how we scale, not just what we build.

 🚀 What You Need to Be Successful: 
 You bring 3+ years of experience in customer success, account management, or similar roles within a B2B environment.

 You are fluent in English. Proficiency in additional languages is a plus.

 With the strong background in client-facing roles you bring, you know how to engage stakeholders at every level, bridging the gap between technical execution and executive leadership.

 You have an interest in software development, are eager to learn new tools and technologies, and bring basic coding experience.

 You quickly grasp complex processes & technical requirements allowing you to create tailored solutions that deliver value for both clients and the business.

 You put the customer first, anticipate their needs, and focus on delivering solutions that improve satisfaction and the overall experience.

 You are based in Munich and able to work from the office 3 days per week.

 🌟 How We Set You Up to Be Successful 
 We don’t just define what success looks like – we actively support you in getting there through a structured, hands-on onboarding process during your first six months with us.
 Onboarding sessions with your hiring manager & COO, Ksenia, to understand your role, goals, and priorities.

 Onboarding sessions with our CEO, Felix, to learn about CONROO’s vision, strategy, and business.

 HR onboarding, with our People Partner, Hind, covering our values, tools, policies, and processes.

 A buddy system to support you during your first 2 months.

 Clear goals for your first 1, 3, and 5 months, with expectations defined from day one so you know how success is measured.

 We know that starting a new role can be overwhelming. That’s why we provide clear documentation, a structured to-do list, and role-specific materials to help you get up to speed quickly.

 👥 About Our Team 
 We’re a team of around 30 curious minds working from our offices in Munich and Nuremberg – and remotely across Germany. We value ownership and a mindset driven by continuous learning. We take ideas seriously, see them through, and aren’t afraid to roll up our sleeves when challenges arise. As we grow, we keep raising the bar, looking for smarter, better ways to work – and have fun in the process together along the way.

jobs.title: Product Owner (m|w|d)
jobs.description:
Deine Rolle bei uns

 Als Product Owner übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle zwischen Fachbereich, Stakeholdern und Entwicklungsteam. Du arbeitest dich schnell in komplexe Geschäftsprozesse ein, strukturierst fachliche Anforderungen und sorgst dafür, dass daraus tragfähige, nutzerorientierte und wirtschaftlich sinnvolle Softwarelösungen entstehen.
Dabei behältst du Nutzer- und Geschäftsnutzen, technische Abhängigkeiten und Projektziele im Blick, setzt klare Prioritäten und schaffst ein gemeinsames Verständnis zwischen Business und Entwicklung.
 Hör dir unseren Podcast Product Owner:innen im Alltag an! 

 Aufgaben

 
 Du analysierst, strukturierst und spezifizierst fachliche Anforderungen gemeinsam mit Kund:innen und Stakeholdern.

 Du hinterfragst Anforderungen, identifizierst die zugrunde liegenden Nutzer- und Geschäftsprobleme und leitest daraus passende Lösungsoptionen ab.

 Du priorisierst und pflegst das Product Backlog unter Berücksichtigung von Nutzen, Scope, Aufwand, Qualität, Risiken und Abhängigkeiten.

 Du übersetzt komplexe fachliche Anforderungen in verständliche und umsetzbare Aufgaben, User Stories und Akzeptanzkriterien für das Entwicklungsteam.

 Du moderierst Workshops und Abstimmungen mit Fachbereichen, Entwicklung, UX/UI, Architektur und weiteren Stakeholdern.

 Du sorgst für Transparenz bei Anforderungen, Prioritäten und fachlichen Zielen und beziehst relevantes Nutzer- und Stakeholderfeedback in die Weiterentwicklung ein.

 Du begleitest Refinements, Sprint Plannings, Reviews und fachliche Abnahmen.

 Du bereitest Entscheidungsgrundlagen vor, kommunizierst Zielkonflikte transparent und erkennst Risiken sowie Abhängigkeiten frühzeitig.

 
 Qualifikation

 
 Du verfügst über mehrjährige Erfahrung als Product Owner, Business Analyst, Requirements Engineer oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle im Software- oder Digitalisierungsumfeld.

 Du kannst komplexe fachliche Anforderungen analysieren, strukturieren und adressatengerecht aufbereiten.

 Du bewertest Nutzer- und Geschäftsnutzen, Aufwand, Qualität, Risiken und Abhängigkeiten und leitest daraus fundierte Prioritäten und Entscheidungen ab.

 Du bewegst dich sicher in komplexen fachlichen und technischen Umfeldern und arbeitest dich schnell in neue Geschäftsprozesse ein.

 Du bringst ein gutes Verständnis moderner Softwareentwicklung mit und vermittelst souverän zwischen Fachbereich und Entwicklung.

 Du kommunizierst sicher mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern, verstehst Nutzerbedürfnisse und wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge und entwickelst auch bei unterschiedlichen Interessen tragfähige Lösungen.

 Du hast Erfahrung mit agilen Arbeitsweisen sowie idealerweise mit Jira und Confluence.

 Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, strukturiert und mit einem hohen Maß an Selbstorganisation.

 Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens C1-Niveau).

 
 Benefits

 
 Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit, remote zu arbeiten

 Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten inkl. Übernahme von Weiterbildungskosten

 Flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege

 Individuelle Entfaltung und ein respektvolles Miteinander

 Offene Unternehmenskultur, angenehme Arbeitsatmosphäre & regelmäßige Teamevents

 Langfristige Perspektiven, betriebliche Altersvorsorge & Krankenversicherung

 Mehr Work-Life-Balance durch eine Kooperation mit unserem Partner voiio

 Wahlweise Zuschuss zu Urban Sports Mitgliedschaft oder BVG Ticket

 Inanspruchnahme von Rabatten über unseren Partner Corporate Benefit

jobs.title: Remote Sr. Product Manager - Revenue Management - 1 year contract (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
About RoomPriceGenie ✨🧞‍♂️
 Founded in 2017, RoomPriceGenie is dedicated to helping hoteliers around the globe achieve optimal pricing. 🌍 We understand that many small hotels face challenges with digitalization, making their operations increasingly complex and often resulting in lost revenue. This is where we come in!
 We have developed a powerful solution that enables hotels to set the right prices in just seconds. ⏱️ Our state-of-the-art algorithm analyzes both internal hotel data and market trends to recommend pricing strategies that enhance revenue and improve booking rates. 
 With customers spanning the globe—from the USA and Canada to Iceland, South Africa, China, Slovenia, Italy, and the UK—RoomPriceGenie has made a meaningful impact in the hospitality industry, and our clients love the results. ❤️
 Now, we are excited to expand our customer base and spread the word about how we can support hoteliers in optimizing their pricing strategies. We invite you to join us on this journey! We actively encourage applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds to enrich our team and drive innovation. 
 
 Your Role 
 As Senior Product Manager for one of our Revenue Management teams at RoomPriceGenie, you'll own the experience where hoteliers see, trust and act on our AI-powered pricing, both in our app and embedded in our partners' PMSs through Revenue Intelligence. This is not a feature-delivery role. We're looking for a senior PM who sets the strategy and direction, makes hard trade-offs, and turns complex pricing logic into decisions a hotelier can make in seconds.
 You'll lead a team of engineers, collaborate closely with design and research and work closely with leadership, Account Management, Integrations, Customer Success and Sales. Your mission: make RoomPriceGenie the pricing tool thousands of independent hotels rely on every day.
 
 What you'll do 
 Product Vision & Strategy 
 Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for your area, anchored in clear business goals: adoption, retention, revenue uplift and expansion.

 Decide what not to build, and bring stakeholders along on why.

 Shape how pricing shows up across surfaces, from our core app to partner integrations and multi-property accounts.

 Champion simplicity and explainability: hoteliers should understand why a price was recommended and feel confident acting on it.

 Discovery & Delivery 
 Talk to hoteliers regularly and, with UX research, turn hidden friction in their revenue management workflows into strategy, not just backlog items.

 Work closely with the other RM team to turn forecasting and pricing model output into clear experiences that build trust and drive action.

 Drive solutions end to end, from opportunity assessment to measured impact, knowing when to move fast and when to dig deeper.

 Impact & Influence 
 Define and own KPIs for your area, be clear about what moved them and why, and be honest about correlation vs. causation.

 Influence across teams without authority, especially where your area depends on other RM teams, Reporting and Integrations.

 
 Your Profile 
 5+ years as a Senior Product Manager, ideally in B2B SaaS, with clear ownership of outcomes, not just outputs.

 A track record of making complex systems radically simple

 Comfortable setting strategy in ambiguous spaces and making trade-offs with incomplete information.

 Genuine excitement about how AI is reshaping software and how it´s build.

 Plus: Experience in hospitality tech, revenue management systems or pricing.

 You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences, including leadership.

 You're a curious, structured thinker with strong product intuition.

 You can say no to a stakeholder and keep the relationship intact.

 You ask "why" until it's clear, and explain "how" until it clicks.

 You reflect honestly on what didn't work.

 At RoomPriceGenie, we don’t just offer jobs; we offer an adventure! 🚀 Join us in an exciting startup atmosphere where you can grow your career while changing the world for tens of thousands of independent hoteliers. 🌍 Our global and diverse team is fueled by passion and a shared mission. We thrive in a culture that’s all about transparency, respect, and making a real impact together.

jobs.title: Senior Product Lifecycle Manager
jobs.description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.
 
 We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.
 
 Here’s what this particular role covers.
 
 🛠️ About our Program Management Team 
 Wayve’s Program Management team turns complex technical goals into coordinated delivery. Working closely with engineering, product, safety and validation teams, we align priorities, manage dependencies and bring clarity to ambiguous challenges. We combine technical depth with cross-functional leadership to help teams move faster, more predictably and with purpose—focusing on meaningful outcomes rather than process for its own sake.
 As Senior Product Lifecycle Manager, you’ll connect Wayve’s product milestones to the detailed technical plans, system-level artefacts and readiness evidence needed to deliver them. You’ll lead complex, multi-team programmes from one milestone to the next, ensuring teams work from a shared, credible plan across our Level 2 and Level 4 products.
 
 🧠 Your day-to-day 
 Partner with engineering and product leads to translate product milestones into integrated cross-team schedules, priorities and delivery plans.

 Review technical progress, backlog health, dependencies and system-level evidence to determine whether programmes are ready to move forward.

 Identify technical risks and sequencing bottlenecks early, then drive the decisions and mitigation plans needed to protect delivery.

 Facilitate difficult conversations around scope, resources and competing priorities, helping teams reach clear and practical decisions.

 Adapt plans quickly as technical understanding, product priorities or delivery constraints change.

 Communicate programme status, schedule changes, risks and decisions clearly and proactively across technical teams and senior stakeholders.

 
 🧩 What you’ll be working on: 
 Owning and maintaining integrated lifecycle plans for complex Level 2 and Level 4 product milestones, creating a clear source of truth across teams.

 Managing cross-team dependencies and critical-path activities across engineering, product, safety, verification and validation.

 Managing system-level artefacts throughout the product lifecycle, ensuring the right information and evidence are available at each milestone.

 Establishing clear milestone-readiness criteria and using technical status, metrics and backlog data to support evidence-based delivery decisions.

 Aligning programme scope, sequencing and resource decisions with Wayve’s strategic and commercial priorities.

 Improving lifecycle-planning practices and tooling so teams can identify risk earlier, coordinate more effectively and deliver with greater predictability.

 
 🙌 You should apply if: 
 You have 5+ years of experience leading complex, multi-team technical or product programmes, with responsibility for planning, execution and delivery across several engineering teams.

 You bring a strong background in the automotive or autonomous-vehicle industry and understand the complexity of delivering integrated vehicle and software products.

 You have the technical depth to work closely with engineers, evaluate complex system architectures and challenge delivery plans constructively—not simply track execution.

 You think in systems, understanding how technical decisions, dependencies and changes in one area affect downstream teams and product outcomes.

 You’re decisive under uncertainty and can make sound prioritisation and trade-off recommendations with incomplete or evolving information.

 You have a strong track record of identifying delivery, technical and dependency risks early and driving them through to resolution.

 You use metrics, technical evidence and backlog health to assess readiness and guide programme decisions.

 You’re product-minded and outcome-focused, connecting delivery decisions to customer value and business impact rather than process completion alone.

 You can facilitate challenging stakeholder conversations, resolve conflicting technical priorities and create alignment without relying on formal authority.

 You communicate clearly in writing and in conversation, tailoring complex programme information for both technical and business audiences.

 You’re proficient with Jira, Confluence and modern backlog, planning and programme-management tools.

 Experience working in a safety-critical, regulated or complex multi-stakeholder environment would be valuable.

 A programme-management qualification such as PMP, CAPM or PRINCE2 would be a plus.

 🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

jobs.title: Product Manager – Traffic (Flow, Jams, Speed Profiles & Moderation)
jobs.description:
Introduction 
 Real-time traffic is at the heart of TomTom's mission to engineer the smartest, most useful map on the planet. Our live and historical traffic products — flow, jams, and speed profiles — power navigation, ADAS, and mobility decisions for the world's leading automotive OEMs, enterprises, and ride-hailing companies. As these customers move faster and expect richer, more accurate content, the way we generate, moderate, and deliver traffic data becomes a decisive competitive advantage. As Product Manager for Traffic Flow, Jams, and Speed Profiles, you will own a core part of TomTom's real-time traffic portfolio and set its multi-year roadmap, grounded in a deep understanding of traffic processing technology and customer needs. You will also own TomTom's traffic moderation tool — enabling the world's leading ride-hailing companies to submit event reports, such as closures — running its user operations and prioritizing its feature roadmap.

 What you'll do 
 

 Own and deliver against Traffic Flow, Traffic Jams, and Speed Profiles — setting the roadmap, OKRs, and quality bar, and taking a leading role in product quality.

 Own and operate TomTom's traffic moderation tool, enabling the world's leading ride-hailing companies to submit event reports such as closures; run user operations and prioritize the tool's feature backlog.

 Bring a deep understanding of real-time traffic processing and jam detection, and use it to manage tradeoffs effectively.

 Focus on outcomes over outputs, tracking metrics such as ETT accuracy, jam detection quality, traffic coverage, and speed profile coverage.

 Lead brainstorms and drive product exploration through prototypes and wireframes.

 Gather deep customer insights from automotive OEMs, government agencies, and enterprise clients, separating high-value initiatives from nice-to-haves.

 Data acumen — able to analyze data from multiple sources, such as GPS traces, probes, STOs, camera observations, and traffic authorities, to drive decisions and assess tradeoffs.

 Build strong cross-functional relationships and steer the product team by removing blockers and escalating appropriately.

 Communicate effectively to internal teams (automotive, navigation, delivery) and external stakeholders using customer problem statements and business logic; deliver concise presentations and lead meetings from standups to stakeholder reviews.

 Maintain product strategy and vision, and contribute to broader Traffic discussions; formulate compelling value propositions tied to articulated problems and product metrics.

 Establish yourself as the subject-matter expert and go-to person for live and historical traffic data products, maintaining trust across product and business teams with visible, citable personal impact.

 What you'll need 
 

 A minimum of 5 years' experience as a Product Manager, preferably in traffic, geospatial, mobility, or automotive domains.

 A bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, or a related field.

 Familiarity with real-time data processing, GPS/probe data, or traffic and mobility analytics (preferred).

 Experience or technical training in data science, analytics, or related disciplines.

 Strong ability to understand, articulate, and represent customer needs and requirements.

 Proven ability to coordinate people and technical resources across multiple teams.

 Effective time management and strong interpersonal communication skills.

 Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including with senior technical and executive audiences.

 Ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

 Strong problem-solving skills and creative, structured thinking.

 What we offer 
 

 A competitive compensation package, of course. 
 

 Time and resources to grow and develop, including a personal development budget and paid leave for learning days, as well as paid access to e-learning resources such as O’Reilly and LinkedIn Learning. 
 

 Time to support life outside of work, with enhanced parental leave plus paid leave to care for loved ones and volunteer in local communities. 
 

 Work flexibility, where TomTom’ers, in agreement with their manager and team, use both the office and home to focus, collaborate, learn and socialize. It’s all about getting the best out of both worlds – we ask TomTom’ers to come to the office two days a week, and the remaining three are free to be worked in either location.
 

 Improve your home office with a setup budget and get extra support with a monthly allowance. 
 

 Enjoy options to work from your home country and abroad for a set number of days each year, to visit family and friends, or to simply explore the world we’re mapping. 
 

 Take the holidays you want with a competitive holiday plan, plus an extra day off to celebrate your birthday. 
 

 Join annual events like our Hackathon and DevDays to bring your ideas to life with talented teammates from around the world.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
We are the platform turning browsing into shopping. We connect 200 million shoppers with deals they love while boosting local sales for hundreds of top retailers and brands.

We help consumers save time and money while making smart shopping decisions, and we support retailers and brands in engaging customers from online research to in-store purchases.

In 2024, Shopfully joined forces with the North American company Flipp, creating a global leader in the sector. Together, we reach 400 million households and serve over 1,000 top retailers and brands across 27 markets, including Europe, Canada, the USA, Latin America, and Australia.

Ready to spark your growth with us?

WHO WE LOOK FOR 🦄

Flipp + Shopfully’s Product team focuses on driving adoption and revenue of our products by identifying the biggest market opportunities, building the case for investing in them, and shipping solutions with engineering, all while representing the voice of our merchant customers.

About the role

The Senior Product Manager is a senior, commercially minded product leader who already understands digital advertising. This role requires a strong strategic thinker with good business sense and solid hands-on product skills who leads opportunity identification, builds decision-ready business cases, and works with engineering to ship.

You will work closely with Sales, Engineering, Data, and Marketing teams across markets to align on key business objectives. By combining market insight, customer feedback, and industry trends, you will make sure our products resonate with merchants and drive growth. We’re looking for someone who can ramp up quickly and contribute independently.

WHAT YOU WILL DO 🏄

Market Understanding and Opportunity Identification

  • Work with Product Marketing, Sales Engineering and customer-facing teams to understand customer needs and prioritize the opportunities that matter most.
  • Find the highest-leverage areas to invest in, and weigh customer demand against our resources, capabilities and strategic direction.
  • Turn complex questions into clear priorities. For example: how do we create more value for retail partners as their strategies move toward e-commerce? How do we find and build opportunities at scale as products launch in new markets?

Business Cases and Strategy

  • Build business cases that size opportunities, weigh revenue trade-offs, and structure a clear recommendation so leadership can make a decision.
  • Own your recommendations, and be ready to explain them and adapt them as you learn.
  • Lead the strategy for how our products differentiate from competitors in the market.
  • Partner with Sales and Finance on pricing and monetization so our offering stays cohesive.

Product Discovery and Delivery

  • Lead discovery with merchants, advertisers, and internal teams to define problems worth solving.
  • Prioritise ruthlessly, balancing revenue impact, effort, and strategic fit.
  • Work hands-on with engineering to define requirements and ship, from alpha and testing through broad launch.
  • Partner with Sales and Marketing on launch timing and readiness, and run retrospectives on past launches to improve future ones.

Alignment and Stakeholder Management

  • Generate cross-functional alignment (Engineering, Data, Sales, Marketing, Content) with a shared focus on goals and timing.
  • Work across markets and levels of seniority, including senior leadership, with confidence.
  • Track progress and impact of product initiatives and communicate results clearly.
  • Build relationships with industry analysts, partners, and customers, and represent Flipp + Shopfully at conferences and industry events where relevant.

 

WHAT YOU WILL NEED 🪄

Must-haves

  • Digital advertising foundations: supply vs. demand, how exchanges, SSPs, and DSPs work, programmatic bidding, pricing models (CPM, CPC, CPV), and fill rate and yield. Ideally gained in ad tech, a retail media network, a publisher, or a marketplace.
  • Proven experience building business cases: sizing opportunities, weighing revenue trade-offs, and structuring recommendations for decisions.
  • High autonomy: you figure things out, own the outcome and don’t need close management.
  • Genuine excitement about using AI tools and rethinking how work gets done.
  • Hands-on product skills: discovery, prioritisation, and working with engineering to ship, not only strategy.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
At CesiumAstro , we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team.
 

 We are currently looking to add a Product Manager to join our new Munich, Germany office, specifically within the Product Engineering Group. This role will focus on building, enhancing, and managing our technical products, working with our team to define and deliver solutions that support our mission of seamless, out-of-the-box space communication systems. 

 

 As a Product Manager at CesiumAstro, you will be at the forefront of managing the entire product lifecycle, from initial concept through to customer integration and support for the European market. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams including engineering, sales, and marketing to develop product strategies that align with our customer needs and business objectives. This role requires a blend of technical knowledge and business acumen, enabling you to drive product decisions and ensure customer success in highly technical environments. 

 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 

 Work closely with senior leadership and engineering teams to define product strategies, ensuring alignment with CesiumAstro’s business objectives and customer needs. 

 Contribute to the development of product roadmaps, prioritizing features and enhancements based on market trends, customer feedback, and technological advancements. 

 Act as a liaison between product engineering, business development/sales, marketing, and customer support teams to deliver products that meet or exceed customer expectations. 

 Facilitate clear communication and collaboration across teams to drive product development cycles. 

 Engage directly with customers to understand their technical needs, challenges, and goals. Leverage this insight to inform product decisions and ensure that solutions meet customer expectations. 

 Oversee the launch of new products and features, working with the marketing team to drive product adoption and customer satisfaction. 

 Provide technical leadership and customer-facing support as needed to ensure smooth product integrations. 

 Lead the identification and implementation of continuous improvements for products and processes, ensuring that CesiumAstro’s products remain industry-leading and meet the evolving demands of our customers. 

 Create and maintain high-quality documentation, including user manuals, application notes, and white papers. 

 Ensure that customer-facing teams are well-equipped with the knowledge to support product offerings. 

 JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS 

 Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in a relevant technical field such as Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics, Computer Science, or related discipline. 

 At least 7 years of experience in the design of communication electronics, technical product development, product management, or application support. 

 In-depth understanding of RF electronics, communication systems, and associated technologies such as digital systems, embedded software, FPGAs, and power electronics. 

 Proven experience working with technical customers, developing strong relationships, and translating their needs into actionable product requirements. 

 Working knowledge of programming languages such as C/C++ or Python. 

 Exceptional troubleshooting skills and ability to understand, diagnose, and solve complex product issues across hardware and software domains. 

 Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. 

 Experience with high-reliability electronics and systems, particularly in the aerospace industry. 

 Familiarity with small satellite systems and their unique requirements 

 PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

At Superchat, we're rebuilding how businesses talk to their customers. AI is becoming the engine of that communication. Integrations are what give that engine teeth: the data, the tools, the systems that turn a clever agent into one that actually closes loops.

Founded in 2020, Superchat has become the platform of choice for 10,000+ businesses worldwide, from globally recognized brands like Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone, and GASAG to the small businesses, dental practices, and one-person startups that need to look bigger than they are. Today, millions of messages flow through Superchat every single day.

We started as a unified inbox: one place for every channel a customer might pick, WhatsApp, email, SMS, Instagram. Then ChatGPT happened, and the second chapter began: AI agents that respond across chat, email, and voice at the quality of the best human teams.

We're 100 people, profitable, and have raised €18M in funding (last round 4.5 years ago, we've been growing on our own money since). Headquartered in Berlin.

We're looking for a Product Manager to join our Integrations team.

In this role, you'll own the surface that decides whether our AI agents are clever demos or systems that actually do work. CRM sync, appointment bookings, call transfers, custom workflows: every action our agents take in the real world runs through your team. Plus our public API, webhooks, and the developer experience that lets partners build on top of us. If you're excited to design APIs, ship agent tooling, and own a surface that gets more strategic every quarter, this might be a great fit.

We're reshaping our product function around three pillars, AI, Integrations, and Core, with a PM in each, operating directly with our founder and CPO Mika. This role is for Integrations.

Learn how product is built from the inside, working side by side with our CPO.

As our Associate Product Manager, you'll work directly with our CPO as a force multiplier for the product team. You'll take on high-impact work across customer research, product data, product marketing and adoption - topics that span the whole product org rather than a single product area. 

Who We Want 

Hungry learner

Structured self-starter

Analytical thinker

Clear communicator

AI-native

 The Mission
 At Fyxer, we believe the only sustainable competitive advantage for a startup is the quality and speed of execution.
 We are looking for a Product Lead who operates like a Staff PM: someone who owns our most important product bets end-to-end, from ambiguous problem space to shipped outcome. You combine sharp product judgment with hands-on discovery skills, and you measure yourself on commercial impact, not output.
 We're not looking for someone to write specs and manage a backlog. We want someone who helps us think better, decide better, and ship better. The goal isn't more process, it's higher quality decisions made faster.
 You will work directly with our Head of Product, CTO, founders and senior engineers to shape what we build and why.
 
 What you will own
 You will not hand anything over. You will own the bet from first insight to shipped impact.
 Own discovery through delivery for our most important product bets, from early ambiguity to validated direction to launched product

 Work directly with engineers and founders from the start of any initiative as the accountable product owner, not a coordinator

 Frame the problem, define the hypothesis, and choose the fastest route to signal: interviews, prototypes, fake doors, experiments, or just shipping and measuring

 Translate messy qualitative and quantitative signals into clear product direction, then drive that direction through to execution

 Set success metrics, make the call on when there's enough signal to build, and own the outcome either way

 Embed structured learning loops into how we operate so insight compounds over time

 Raise the bar of product thinking across the team: coach others, introduce lightweight frameworks, and get the whole company closer to customers

 Who you are
 You are a full-stack product thinker.
 Outcome owner: You connect user behaviour to funnels, retention, and revenue. You think in bets and expected value, not feature lists, and you hold yourself accountable to results.

 Discovery-strong: Genuinely fluent across qualitative research, behavioural insight, and experimentation. You generate strong signal quickly and pick the right method for the decision at hand, rather than outsourcing the thinking.

 Engineering partner: You work shoulder to shoulder with engineers, translating insight into crisp problem framing and practical tradeoffs. Engineers want to work with you because you make the work clearer, not slower.

 Decision oriented: You know when there's enough signal to move. You sharpen hypotheses, clarify thinking, and make confident calls under uncertainty. You'd rather ship and learn than perfect and wait.

 Force multiplier: Your impact shows up in how the whole team operates. You build repeatable systems for discovery and decision-making that outlast any single project.

 The Role
 You will be the senior product voice on our most important initiatives, working directly with the Head of Product, CPGO, founders, and senior engineers. This is not a support function. You will be embedded in high impact work from day one, with real authority over what we build and why.
 You will operate at speed. We care about generating signal quickly, making informed decisions, and shipping fast. You are comfortable working with imperfect information and tightening your thinking as you go.
 You will move fluidly across the full product lifecycle. Some weeks you will be deep in user interviews or pressure testing a major bet, other weeks you will be in the detail with engineers getting something over the line.
 You will have significant autonomy. We expect strong judgment, clear communication, and ownership of outcomes.
 If there are specific tools you believe are critical to moving faster or generating better signal, we will support that. We want you to design the right setup, not work around constraints.
 
 Why Fyxer?
 We are intentional about our team. We believe a small, exceptional team working with extreme focus will always outperform a large, bloated organization.
 Autonomy: We hire people who want ownership and then we actually give it to them.

 Velocity: You will be fast-tracked into senior responsibilities far earlier than at a traditional company.

 Scale: We are on track to hit $100M in revenue by the end of 2026. This is a rare opportunity to join a high-growth rocket ship at the foundational stage.

jobs.title: Founding Product Manager (German-speaking)
jobs.description:
About BoWatt
 BoWatt is building agentic requirements and systems engineering software for manufacturing.
 
 We believe AI will reach PhD-level engineering capability within the next 10 years. This will unlock massive value across complex manufacturing industries. Cars. Planes. Rockets. Factories. Chips. Medical devices. All will be engineered with agents.
 
 We bootstrapped BoWatt to €500k+ ARR before raising our first round. BoWatt is backed by tier-1 investors, including Atlantic Foodlabs, Buildery (CDTM affiliates), and Prequel Ventures, along with angels from Cohere and Luminovo.
 
 You’ll join a small team of startup builders focused on speed, ownership, and execution. Over half the team are former founders, with backgrounds across DeepTech AI, gaming, and other startups. We’ve studied and worked at institutions and companies including Stanford, TUM, Google, EA, and YC-backed AI startups.
 
 The role
 As our Founding Product Manager, you will help determine what BoWatt builds, why we build it, and whether it creates meaningful value for customers.
 
 You will work closely across our commercial, customer success and engineering teams, as well as with our customers. You will develop a deep understanding of complex engineering workflows, turn customer problems into clear product opportunities, and drive initiatives from discovery through launch and iteration.
 
 This is a hands-on product role. You will spend time with customers, work through technical and operational detail, write requirements, make trade-offs, test solutions, and help the team ship quickly.
 
 Lead product discovery - translate complex workflows and customer needs into clear product requirements and success criteria

 Develop a deep understanding of how manufacturing and systems-engineering teams work

 Identify and define the highest-value customer problems for BoWatt to solve

 Help own and prioritise the product roadmap

 Balance strategic opportunities, recurring customer needs, commercial importance, and engineering effort

 Drive product initiatives from initial discovery through scoping, development, launch, and iteration

 Give engineers the context and clarity needed to make strong implementation decisions

 Prototype and test potential solutions with customers before and during development

 Work with Customer Success to turn individual customer feedback into scalable product improvements

 Use qualitative feedback and product data to understand adoption and evaluate whether features are working

 Triage product issues and bugs, make clear prioritisation decisions, and coordinate with Engineering

 Improve BoWatt’s processes for discovery, prioritisation, product delivery, launches, and feedback

 Develop deep expertise in BoWatt’s product, customers, and target industries

 
 During your first six months, you will work closely with our engineering team to build the domain and product knowledge required to take ownership of increasingly important product areas.
 
 You
 You are deeply curious about customers and want to understand how their work actually happens

 You enjoy turning complex, ambiguous problems into clear product decisions

 You combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution

 You can distinguish between an individual customer request and a scalable product opportunity

 You make thoughtful trade-offs and are comfortable deciding with incomplete information

 You write clearly, communicate confidently, and know how to get to the point

 You are comfortable working closely with software engineers and discussing technical constraints

 You move quickly without losing sight of product quality or customer outcomes

 You take ownership of results rather than simply managing tickets and meetings

 You want to build a product function rather than inherit an established playbook

 You are ambitious, resourceful, and excited to become an expert in a complex industry

 
 Requirements
 At least two years of experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, Product Operations, or a comparable product-building role

 Experience shipping B2B software in close collaboration with engineers

 Experience conducting product discovery and translating customer problems into clear requirements

 Strong prioritisation, project management, and stakeholder-management skills

 The ability to understand technical products and communicate with engineers, technical users, and business stakeholders

 Fluent German required; English is our internal working language

 Four days per week in our Munich office at Balanstraße

 Experience with enterprise software, AI products, manufacturing, engineering, systems engineering, or early-stage startups is a bonus

 
 What we offer
 Competitive salary based on experience

 Participation in BoWatt’s Founders Pool: 5–10% virtual equity package

 Significant ownership over an important part of BoWatt’s product

 The opportunity to help build BoWatt’s product function and ways of working

jobs.title: Growth Product Manager - Website & Conversion
jobs.description:
Why This Role Exists
 At Pennylane, our website plays a pivotal role in acquiring and converting customers, transforming traffic from paid acquisition, SEO, partnerships, and other channels into sign-ups, demo bookings, and product adoption.
  
 As we accelerate our Financial Services offering, including pro account, and the monetization of our existing customer base , we are seeking a Growth Product Manager to own conversion across these strategic areas.
  
 You will lead the production and optimization of website pages and paid landing pages, from identifying friction to measuring business impact.
  
 You will join the Website team within Growth and collaborate closely with Growth Engineers and Data in a multidisciplinary squad.
  
 🌍 About Pennylane
 Pennylane is one of France’s leading fintech unicorns, building the financial and accounting operating system for European SMEs and accounting firms.
  
 Founded in 2020, we help business owners make better decisions and empower accountants to focus on advising their clients.
  
 Key Figures and Ambition
 💻 Over 1.3 million SMEs already work with Pennylane

 🤝 More than 7,000 accounting firms use our platform

 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Over 1,100 Pennylaners from more than 25 nationalities

 💰 More than €400 million raised since launch

 🌍 Remote-friendly, international culture expanding across Europe

  
 What You’ll Do
 You will own conversion across the Financial Services and Monetization scope , working across website pages, paid landing pages, product journeys, experimentation, and measurement.
  
 Own CRO and Experimentation
 Define and execute the conversion strategy for key journeys, including pro account landing pages, pricing and product pages, demo-booking journeys, self-sign-up, and upsell flows 

 Build and run a continuous A/B testing program, from ideation and scoping to sizing, analysis, and ship-or-kill decisions

 Identify conversion friction and opportunities through analytics and behavioral insights

 Develop clear hypotheses based on user behavior, business priorities, and funnel performance

 Ensure experiments are measured against meaningful business outcomes

  
 Manage the Website Conversion Roadmap
 Own and prioritize the conversion roadmap for your scope based on expected impact and feasibility

 Turn opportunities into actionable briefs, specifications, and delivery plans

 Work closely with Growth Engineers, Data, Design, and other stakeholders to ship improvements

 Coordinate QA, launch, and post-launch analysis

 Own key Financial Services journeys, including pro account activation and the accountant portal

jobs.description:

 At Omegga, we're on a mission to reinvent how AI and spectroscopy can drive positive change for animals, people and the planet. We started with a clear objective: eliminate chick culling on a global scale through early, non-invasive detection. This outdated practice still impacts billions of lives, and we're here to change that. We're not building for the niche, we're building for the global standard.
 Today, our systems are already in use, and the focus is on scaling performance, robustness, and deployment across an international customer base. For us, scaling means more than growth. It means changing an industry for the better.
 We are looking for people who take ownership, think in systems, and want to help turn a working product into the industry benchmark. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

 What We're Looking For
 We're looking for a Technical Project Manager who runs our hardware development projects end to end and holds the thread between our engineers, our external partners, and our leadership. Our system combines optics, mechanics, electronics, and embedded control with machine learning on top. Most of what you manage is hardware, but every hardware decision touches software and data science, and you make sure those pieces move together.
 Development happens in-house, but parts of it are outsourced to production partners and component suppliers. You keep those external work packages aligned with our internal timelines, specifications, and quality standards.  Manage the outsourced parts of our development with production partners and component suppliers: scope, specifications, timelines, and quality

 Integrate partner timelines into the overall project plan and resolve conflicts before they become blockers

 What You Bring
 3 to 5 years of experience in technical project management in a hardware development environment: machinery, medtech, robotics, optics, or comparable

jobs.description:
JustPlay is searching for an experienced Senior Product Manager - Ad Traffic Quality to join our team to take ownership of safeguarding our players and protecting our platform’s integrity by designing, implementing, and optimizing innovative systems to detect and prevent fraud across our loyalty gaming ecosystem.

 Collaborate with data, engineering, and product teams to build robust detection pipelines, alert systems, and responsive workflows.

 Prioritize fraud-related KPIs such as false positives, chargeback rates, fraud velocity, and user friction metrics, driving continuous optimization.

 Integrate A/B testing and iterative validation to refine detection models and user intervention flows.

 Influence product design to incorporate fraud-resilient ad experiences and sustainable monetisation practices, while minimizing friction for legitimate players.

 Stay informed on global fraud trends in mobile gaming and ad revenue-based platforms to keep our defenses innovative and effective.
 

 Job Requirements 
 4+ years of product management experience, ideally in digital products with complex user behavior and ad-driven monetisation models.

 Strong experience in AdTech or ad monetisation, such as attribution, measurement platforms, or ad networks.

 Strong analytical and data-driven mindset, with experience using behavioral data, patterns, and signals to improve product decisions.

 Proficient in designing and measuring the impact of A/B tests in risk and fraud scenarios.

 Skilled at cross-functional collaboration with engineers, analysts, and operations to drive implementation of scalable fraud solutions.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Turn new revenue opportunities into products construction companies pay for. 
 
Your mission
 Cosuno is the marketplace where construction companies run their tenders: general contractors invite subcontractors to bid, and subcontractors find and win new projects. More than €100 billion in bid volume has already been tendered on our platform.

We see several ways to grow from here, such as new modules for existing customers or customer segments we don't serve yet. As our Senior PM for Growth, you'll own one of these opportunities and you'll help choose the next. Next to that, you'll take care of the day-to-day product work in your area.
 
 What you'll do
 Find the real problem. Talk to customers, many of whom aren't tech-savvy, dig into our data and work out who has the problem, how much it matters and what we need to build.

 Put AI to work. Construction still runs on a lot of manual work. You'll find where AI can replace it and turn that into products customers love.

 Test before you build. Prototype and run small experiments with real customers before Engineering commits, then ship with Design and Engineering.

 Bring it to market. Launch with Sales, Marketing and Customer Success, from positioning and pricing to enablement, and measure what it brings in.

 After one year, you've taken your first opportunity to real customers, you're working on your second, and the new offerings bring in measurable revenue.
 
 How we work
 Full ownership. You own your growth opportunity end to end, from the first customer conversation to the revenue it brings in. Design and Engineering build with you.

 Close to the customer. You'll talk to customers constantly.

 Fast and data-driven. We ship every two weeks, test ideas before we build them and judge every launch by its numbers.

 AI-first. We're an AI-first company. AI is at the core of our product, and we work with Claude Code and other AI tools every day. For every opportunity, your first question is: where can AI take manual work off our customers' hands?
 

 What you bring
 3–5 years as a product manager in B2B SaaS, and you want to stay hands-on

 You've taken a new revenue opportunity (a module, upsell, segment or market) from idea to a product customers pay for

 You've shipped AI features that customers actually use, and you use AI tools every day in your own work

 You work with numbers and experiments, and you change course when the data says so

 You explain complex things simply, to a site manager as well as to management

 German at C2 level and fluent English: our customers work in German, our engineering team in English

 Experience with two-sided marketplaces, or with construction or another industry that is just going digital.

 
 Why us?
 Real impact: You own a growth opportunity, with short decision paths to our Head of Product, and you see the result in our numbers.

 A head start: Your first opportunity is prepared for you, so you can get going from day one.

 Competitive compensation: A salary above the market average.

 Work-life balance: Work fully remotely from anywhere in Europe, or from our office in Berlin Kreuzberg.

 Top-notch equipment: A new MacBook Pro.

 A great team: Regular company off-sites and team events.

 Job security: A permanent contract in a stable, well-funded company.

 Growth & feedback: An open feedback culture with regular 1:1s and development conversations.

 About us
 Cosuno – Revolutionizing construction through technology.

We are Cosuno – a fast-growing tech startup that is making the construction industry more efficient and transparent with our digital platform for tenders and procurement processes. Our goal: to solve the most complex challenges in the industry with innovation and simplicity.

Artificial intelligence is the key to our solution: it analyzes millions of price data points and helps construction companies create precise and efficient bids. This not only saves our customers time but also helps them avoid unnecessary costs.

But for us, it's not just about technology – it's about the people who drive it. At Cosuno, you will work with creative minds who are reshaping the construction industry. We believe in diversity because we know that the best ideas come from different perspectives. An inclusive work environment is a given for us.

Join us – Build the future of construction.

 metrify ist die Smart-Metering-Unit von Enpal und die digitale Infrastruktur für ein intelligentes Energie-Ökosystem. Mit zehntausenden installierten iMSys und skalierbaren Prozessen machen wir Energie messbar, steuerbar und wirtschaftlich nutzbar – und schaffen gemeinsam mit Partnern die Basis für neue Geschäftsmodelle der Energiewende.
 Deine Aufgaben 
 Du übernimmst eigenständig die Kommunikation mit unseren wichtigsten Accounts (Netzbetreiber und Lieferanten) und baust langfristig vertrauensvolle Partnerschaften auf.

 Du koordinierst die Umsetzung von Projekten zwischen externen Marktpartner:innen und internen Fachbereichen und hast jederzeit den Überblick über Aufgaben, Timings und Verantwortlichkeiten.

 Du schaffst Verbindlichkeiten, dokumentierst Projektfortschritt transparent und hältst Aufgaben bei allen Beteiligten konsequent nach.

 Du übernimmst Eskalationskommunikation und sorgst für partnerschaftliche Zusammenarbeit auch in herausfordernden Situationen. Du planst, führst und dokumentierst Marktpartner-Calls gemeinsam mit internen Expert:innen.

 Du erkennst Optimierungspotenziale entlang der Marktpartner-Prozesse und entscheidest KPI- und impactbasiert, welche Themen priorisiert werden.

 Du unterstützt beim Aufbau von Dashboards, Tracking-Mechanismen und transparenten KPI-Strukturen.

 Du koordinierst bereichsübergreifend mit Product, Operations und weiteren Fachbereichen und treibst Themen aktiv voran.

 Du arbeitest dich tief in technische und operative Zusammenhänge der Marktkommunikation rund um Smart Meteringein.

 Du unterstützt dabei, Strukturen und Prozesse in einem schnell wachsenden Umfeld weiterzuentwickeln.

  
 Dein Profil 
 Du hast mehrere Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung gesammelt – idealerweise im Energiemarkt, Account Management, Operations oder Projektmanagement.

 Du kommunizierst souverän, professionell und empathisch – schriftlich wie mündlich. Dein Deutsch ist auf C2-Niveau.

 Du klärst Zuständigkeiten und Erwartungen frühzeitig und setzt Grenzen transparent – ohne die Partnerbeziehung zu belasten.

 Du trittst in Terminen souverän auf, bleibst auch in Eskalationen ruhig und führst Gespräche lösungsorientiert.

 Du behältst auch in komplexen Situationen den Überblick, übernimmst Verantwortung und arbeitest strukturiert.

 Du hast ein gutes analytisches Verständnis und kannst Prioritäten sicher einordnen.

 Du arbeitest gerne bereichsübergreifend und koordinierst unterschiedliche Stakeholder effizient.

 Du hast Interesse an technischen Themen, Systemen, Daten und Prozessen rund um Smart Metering und Energiewirtschaft.

 Du hast Lust auf ein dynamisches Umfeld und möchtest Verantwortung in einer zentralen Rolle mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum übernehmen.

 Erfahrung im Energiemarkt, mit Netzbetreibern oder Smart Metering ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss.

 Du bist interessiert, auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst? Bewirb dich trotzdem! Wir freuen uns darauf, dein Potenzial zu entdecken - unabhängig davon, ob deine Erfahrung jede einzelne Voraussetzung erfüllt. ☀️
  
 Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen 
 Arbeite in Deutschlands erstem grünen Unicorn - Gestalte aktiv die solare Energiewende mit.

 Die Sonne scheint auf der ganzen Welt - Bei Enpal arbeitest du mit einem hochmotivierten, diversen Team aus über 65 Nationalitäten.

 Das ideale Setup für deinen Fokus - Wir sind überzeugt, dass exzellente Ergebnisse dort entstehen, wo die Bedingungen stimmen. Deshalb setzen wir auf ein hybrides Arbeitskonzept, das dir die Freiheit gibt, immer genau so zu arbeiten, wie es am besten zu deinen Aufgaben passt. Du brauchst neue Impulse auf internationalem Niveau? Mit Workflex bieten wir, abhängig von deiner Verantwortung, die Möglichkeit, deine Tätigkeit bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr ins Ausland zu verlegen.

 Grown-up Business & Startup Spirit - In unserem modernen Office in Berlin-Friedrichshain findest du von höhenverstellbaren Tischen, Tischtennisplatte bis gefüllten Getränkekühlschränken und Barista-Coffee alles was das Herz begehrt.

 Dein Kick-start bei Enpal - Onboarding-Tag mit Welcome Bag, Buddy-Programm und einem Team, das dich wirklich abholt.

 Bleib auf dem Laufenden & gestalte mit - Transparente All-Hands, kurze Entscheidungswege und eine offene Feedback-Kultur, denn ohne Fehler gibt es keinen Fortschritt.

 Energiewende geht nur gemeinsam - Bei Enpal erwartet dich ein legendärer Teamspirit und unvergessliche Team- und Companyevents.

jobs.description:
L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès 

 Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean. 

 

 Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA. 

 

 La practice AI Build accompagne les entreprises de tous secteurs dans la conception et le développement d’applications web sur-mesure. Habitués à intervenir au sein d’écosystèmes IT existants, nous intégrons nos solutions avec des outils imposés - ERP, CRM, plateformes métiers complexes - et savons nous intégrer efficacement dans les systèmes développés par nos clients. 
 

 
 Tes futures missions : 

 

 
 Le rôle du Senior Product Manager est d’aider l’équipe à maximiser la valeur du produit en priorisant et livrant des fonctionnalités de qualité, au service de la satisfaction client. 

 En tant que Senior PM, tu es owner de l'intégralité du cycle de vie produit — de la discovery à la mise en production — et tu agis en véritable business partner des équipes produit de nos clients.

 
 Piloter le produit de bout en bout : 

 
 
 Conduire la phase de discovery : recherche utilisateur, définition de la vision produit, cadrage des hypothèses métier à valider.

 
 Piloter le delivery au quotidien en appliquant la méthodologie Lean : gestion du backlog, rédaction de user stories claires, planification des sprints.

 
 Assurer le suivi opérationnel ("run") post-livraison dans une logique You build it, you run it : garantir la stabilité, la qualité et la performance du produit en production.

 
 Mesurer et démontrer la valeur métier délivrée en pilotant des expérimentations, en analysant l'impact des mises en production et en itérant rapidement sur les hypothèses.

 
 Être le business partner des équipes produit client : 

 
 
 Agir en partenaire stratégique des Lead Product Managers et Heads of Product côté client, en les aidant à prendre les meilleures décisions produit.

 
 Orchestrer les parties prenantes (risques, conformité, marketing, métiers) pour aligner les priorités et dérisquer les sujets complexes.

 
 Rendre le travail visible et faciliter les arbitrages via des review decks, synthèses d'impact et rituels de pilotage adaptés aux interlocuteurs.

 
 Garantir l'excellence de l'équipe : 

 
 
 Traduire les enjeux produit en exigences claires pour l'équipe technique, en t'appuyant sur l'analyse des usages, les benchmarks et l'étude de l'environnement concurrentiel.

 
 Anticiper les risques, résoudre les problèmes et contribuer aux routines d'amélioration continue (rétrospectives, résolutions de problèmes)

 
 Comprendre les préférences et les contraintes du client pour organiser une réaction rapide et adaptée en cas d'incident ou de changement de priorité.

 
 

 
 Une méthodologie basée sur l’apprentissage continu 

 

 Chez Theodo, nous avons construit notre approche tech autour d’une conviction forte : on développe d’abord les personnes, avant de développer les produits. 

 

 Notre Lean Tech® System met l’accent sur l’apprentissage continu : tu évolueras dans un environnement qui investit sur le long terme, où l’objectif est de te permettre de progresser chaque jour, tout en construisant des produits utiles et performants pour nos clients.

 

 Profil recherché 

 
 
 Diplômé·e d'une grande école d'ingénieur ou de commerce , avec 4 ans d'expérience minimum , dont au moins 2 ans en tant que Product Manager (PM, Senior PM ou Lead PM).

 Tu utilises l'IA au quotidien pour prototyper rapidement , rédiger des spécifications de qualité et effectuer des modifications mineures en production en quasi-autonomie.

 Solide maîtrise de la discovery : recherche utilisateur, cadrage d'hypothèses, définition de vision.

 Fort en problem solving : tu sais structurer un problème, identifier les leviers d'action et prendre des décisions rapides avec des informations incomplètes.

 Excellent relationnel : capable d'adopter la bonne posture face à des interlocuteurs senior

 Posture client first : disponible, réactif, à l'écoute

 Forte envie d'apprendre et de progresser , capable de challenger son équipe et d'être challengé·e en retour

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
About Us 
 Lupa is building a category defining product the industry has never seen before.
 We're the AI-native operating system for veterinary practices and pet parents, replacing the fragmented, clunky systems vets have tolerated for years with a single intelligent platform for scheduling, client communication, clinical documentation, and AI-driven care guidance. Practices run more efficiently, vets get back to doing what they love, and pet parents feel more connected to their animals' health than ever.
 The traction speaks for itself: founded in 2023 and already one of Europe's top 100 AI startups, with a team of 50 people, 10x growth in twelve months, the UK market leader, and now charging hard into the US and Europe. We have $25M in funding, 3M+ pets on the platform, and a buzzing HQ in Paddington, London. We've attracted exceptional people from the likes of ElevenLabs, Palantir, Google, DeepMind, BCG, Meta, and AWS and we're just getting started.
 This is a rare chance to join a rocket ship at exactly the right moment and we're looking for exceptional people to help us fly it.
 
 In this role, you will: 
 Own product areas end-to-end, from zero-to-one discovery through to shipping, measuring, and iterating in production

 Define and drive the roadmap for your domain, making hard prioritisation calls that balance customer pain, AI capability, and commercial impact

 Work at the intersection of AI and B2B SaaS. defining how LLM-powered features get embedded into clinical and operational workflows that vets actually use

 Run tight discovery loops with customers; getting into practices, watching how vets work, and translating messy real-world problems into sharp product decisions

 Collaborate daily with Engineering and Design to ship fast, without sacrificing quality or coherence

 Align with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to ensure what you build lands well and drives measurable outcomes

 Define success metrics for every initiative and hold yourself accountable to them

 Contribute to how the product team operates, our processes are still forming and you’ll help shape them

 
 Your background looks something like: 
 Solid background as a PM at a SaaS company, ideally one that was building 0–1 products in a fast-moving, resource-constrained environment

 Experience shipping AI-powered features, you understand what LLMs can and can’t do, and you know how to design around their limitations

 A track record of owning a roadmap and making difficult trade-offs under real constraints, not just managing a backlog

 Strong technical fluency, you don’t need to write the code, but you can engage meaningfully in architectural conversations

 Experience in health-tech, vertical SaaS, or a regulated industry (nice to have)

 Background at a FAANG company or high-growth VC-backed startup (nice to have)

 
 As a person, you: 
 Get energised by building from scratch, blank-page problems don’t intimidate you, they motivate you

 Are relentlessly driven by outcomes, not output, shipping a feature means nothing if it doesn’t move the metric

 Move fast and make decisions with incomplete information, then course-correct quickly when you’re wrong

 Have a genuine passion for product. you think about it outside of work, and it shows in how you talk about it

 Are excited to work in-person from our Paddington, London HQ

 Value working with people who are kind, ambitious, and pragmatic

 
 What does success look like in 6 months? 
 You’ve shipped something meaningful that customers are using and talking about

 You own your domain with confidence, Engineering, Design, and Go-to-Market trust your judgement and come to you first

 You’re already influencing the roadmap beyond your immediate area and shaping how the team thinks about AI-native product development

 Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean.

 Chez Theodo HealthTech, l'entité experte en santé, nous accompagnons tous les acteurs de la santé dans le développement des dispositifs médicaux digitaux sur-mesure. Grâce à notre expérience du Lean et de la tech, combinées à notre connaissance de la santé, nous concevons et développons des dispositifs médicaux numériques qui s'intègrent dans le parcours de soins des patients (thérapies digitales - DTx, essais cliniques virtualisés, parcours de soins digitalisés). Notre but est de réaliser des produits qui changent la vie de leurs utilisateurs, qu'ils soient soignants ou patients. 
 

 Tes futures missions : 

 En tant que Product Manager , ton rôle est d’aider l’équipe à maximiser la valeur du produit en priorisant et livrant des fonctionnalités de qualité, au service de la satisfaction client. Tu seras pour cela encadré par un Lead Product Manager. 

 

 - Prioriser et livrer des fonctionnalités à forte valeur ajoutée , en respectant les jalons et les engagements pris auprès du client. 

 - Montrer la valeur et l’avancement de l’équipe en rendant le travail visible et en facilitant les décisions du client (review decks, daily mails,…). 

 - Comprendre les préférences du client et organiser une réaction rapide et adaptée en cas de problème, en s’appuyant sur des outils comme le modèle de valeur, les questionnaires clients et les résolutions de problème. 

 - Piloter le delivery au quotidien en appliquant la méthodologie Lean : gestion du backlog, rédaction de user stories claires et planification des sprints. 

 - Collaborer étroitement avec le client pour comprendre ses besoins, faciliter ses décisions et co-construire les solutions. 

 - Traduire les enjeux produit en exigences claires pour l’équipe technique , en t’appuyant sur l’analyse des usages, l’étude de l’environnement et les benchmarks. 

 - Aider l’équipe à tenir ses engagements en anticipant les risques, en résolvant les problèmes et en contribuant aux routines d’amélioration continue (résolution de problèmes, rétrospectives). 

 

 Les problématiques et les technos sont très différentes d’un projet à l’autre, voici quelques exemples :

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.description:
Head of Product 

 Our mission for you

 European energy costs are 2x compared to US and China. Electricity demand is expected to double by 2050. Market price volatility & complexity are here to stay. The backbone of Europe's industrial economy is at risk — and companies need to act now.
 trawa is building the solution: the first integrated B2B energy platform that orchestrates procurement, energy management, and flexibility steering in one product. Supply, Manage, Flex — combined. That integration unlocks up to 30% in recurring electricity cost savings — all while helping companies switch to renewable energy.
 

 We're the fastest-growing B2B energy platform in Europe. Active in Germany and Austria now, and expanding operations to a third market in 2027. We're on the road to European scale and move fast — the market window is open and we intend to own it.
 trawa is a scale-up based in Berlin with ~100 FTE, ~30 of whom work in Product & Tech. We've raised over €35M to date, including a €24M Series A in May 2025, backed by Balderton, Headline, Speedinvest, AENU, Magnetic, and Tiny VC. All three founders are on board and 100% committed to build the utility of the future.

 We're looking for a Head of Product to own vision, strategy, and execution across the entire customer journey. You'll report directly to the CEO, with close collaboration with the CTO and COO. You will join the leadership team alongside other department leaders. You'll shape the product that makes European industry competitive again — and you'll do it at pace. This role is based in Berlin. trawa is an "office first" company, which means you will work from the headquarters in Berlin with our international, dynamic team.

 Your team

 You will lead a well-established team of 6 Product Managers and Designers embedded in 6 interdisciplinary teams in Product & Engineering. You will be the key decision-maker for what the teams work on. Our main customer segment is the German Mittelstand, therefore fluent German is required for this position.

 You'll drive the evolution of three key areas:

 Product Vision & Strategy: Own the product vision for the customer-facing products and roadmap across Supply, Manage, and Flex. Turn market dynamics and customer pain into a clear, prioritized strategy that compounds value across products. Internal products such as Trading platform as well as Energy Utility Platform are out of scope for this role.
 Value Delivery at Scale: Drive execution across teams, products, and geographies. Own the metrics that matter. Turn data into decisions and trade-offs into momentum.
 Team & Organisation: Build and lead high-performing product teams. Partner with Engineering, Design, GTM, and Operations. Create an environment where exceptional people do their best work.

 Who we are looking for

 Product Vision Leader: You deeply understand customer problems and translate them into a compelling product vision that aligns the entire company. You communicate strategy with clarity and conviction. You rally cross-functional teams around shared goals.
 Product Excellence: You have excelled as a Product Leader (Staff, Head of, VP) at a fast-paced scale-up. Proven track record of shipping products customers love that drive measurable business results.
 Value Delivery at Scale: You lead teams that deliver value at scale — shipping regularly, holding themselves accountable to outcomes, not just output. You set the bar for execution quality and speed across products, teams, and markets.
 Software Builder: Expert in building B2B software products, ideally experienced with working with customers in the Commercial & Industrial segment. You understand and master software product dynamics — activation, retention, pricing and upsell along the full customer lifecycle.
 Seasoned Executor: You deliver in high-paced environments with clear target achievement. You thrive in uncertainty — creating structure, driving momentum, and turning ambiguity into action. You prioritize with clarity and ship relentlessly.
 AI-Native Builder: At trawa, we embrace new technology and use it to our competitive advantage. Core decision processes in trading and energy operations run on AI-based predictions. Customer success, sales enablement as well as Operations are fueled by agentic workflows. We are reinventing what a modern utility looks like — driving cost-to-serve toward €0 and increasing trading profits through AI-based signal processing. You will have the mandate and the environment to reinvent product development, tooling, and ways of working with AI across the organization.
 Energy Expert (Strong Plus): Deep energy market expertise is beneficial — but not a prerequisite.
 At trawa, we're dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly, we encourage you to apply — you may be the right fit for this or another opportunity.

 
90 Day Goals

 After 6 Weeks (Onboarding)

jobs.title: Lead Product Designer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
About Hilo by Aktiia 
 High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health.
 We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US.
 We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. Applicants must already hold a valid visa or work permit for their country of residence, as Hilo is not able to provide visa sponsorship.
 
 Role overview 
 UX is our number one priority, and we need a design leader who consistently turns design into business outcomes. As Lead Product Designer, you set the quality bar for our app, own our design system and drive our biggest product bets from first idea to shipped result. You are hands-on: you prototype, you craft, you ship.
 You will report directly to our Head of Design and work with product and engineering every day. You will be the design partner who keeps the whole product consistent and high quality, together with our Lead UX Writer and a Senior Product Designer.
 You will have real ownership on a health product people use every day, in a business-critical, high-visibility role where UX is our top priority. You join a team with high talent density, people who raise your game, and a shared focus on speed, clarity and craft.
 Location: Fully remote, open to candidates across the UK and Europe.

 Core responsibilities 
 Direction & Outcomes
 Set the design direction and quality bar across the app, from new features to health insights and early vision work.
 Define the success measures for your work and own the business results.
 Design System & Prototyping
 Own our design system, built to work with AI tools, and keep it consistent through tokens and clear decisions.
 Show instead of tell, with high-fidelity prototypes and motion built with AI tools and our design system.
 Leadership & Collaboration
 Raise the bar for the team. Support, coach and unblock other designers, and give clear feedback.
 Challenge product and engineering with evidence, persuade stakeholders and make clear, documented decisions.
 Work daily with product managers and design engineers.
 
 Requirements 
 
 Background & Experience 
 Essential
 Proven design leadership, with a track record of consistently delivering strong business outcomes.
 2 to 3 shipped case studies that demonstrate high impact: the problem, your hypothesis, your decisions, the measured result.
 Outstanding visual design craft: hierarchy, typography, motion and attention to detail.
 High-fidelity prototypes and videos of your work, ideally built with AI tools such as Claude or Lovable.
 Daily, practical use of AI tools and experience with AI-ready design systems.
 Fluent Figma, including components, variables and tokens.
 Strong product thinking: you work with data, hypotheses and measurements.
 Ideally health, consumer, behavior change or regulated products.
 A public portfolio website (required with your application).
 Nice to Have
 Mobile apps, connected devices, simple prototypes in code.
 How you work
 AI first — You are already playing with AI tools and you are excited about what they make possible.
 Builder — You ship, and you can spin up something from nothing.
 Bias for action — You are autonomous and self-sufficient. You don't wait for a brief and you don't need chasing.
 Disciplined — Tokens, not screenshots. Decision logs, not memories.
 Curious — You want to know why, not just what. You can explain who made each decision and how.
 Clear under pressure — Medical regulation and different market rules are design problems, not excuses.
 This isn't for you if
 You need all requirements, research and data before you start.
 You measure screens shipped, not outcomes moved.
 You'd rather list risks than own one.
 How we hire
 Recruiter screen (30 min)
 Portfolio interview with the Head of Design (60 min): visual craft, prototyping, AI fluency
 Product thinking and interaction design deep dive
 Cross-functional conversation with design engineers and product
 Final conversation with senior leadership (finalists)
 What success looks like
 You take something off our plate and it gets done.
 If it won't happen, you tell us first.
 You bring the problem, the root cause and options.
 You flag risk to dates early, while we can still change it.
 The product feels consistent, fast and high quality, and design outcomes show up in the numbers.
 Benefits
