jobs.description:
About Us

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. 

 

About the team

Fans have opinions. Fanatics Markets lets them trade on them.

Fanatics connects 100M+ fans with around 900 sports partners across Commerce, Collectibles, and Betting & Gaming. We’re now building Fanatics Markets, and we want it to be the biggest and best prediction market for sports, sports culture, crypto and beyond.

Our core customer is a sports-first trader who is more likely to use Robinhood or Hyperliquid than a sportsbook. We’re building a suite of tools to give this customer the best possible trading experience from their phone. We have a small, high-performing team and a very flat structure to ensure the best ideas win.

About the role

We’re hiring a Senior Product Manager who is highly nimble and can solve a wide range of problems across the entire product stack. You’ll come in, understand the problem, define a solution, ship, iterate and move on to the next problem. Here are some example problems you might solve:

  • Building the best perpetual futures product for a sports-first trader

  • Building a “pro” trading mode for our best customers

  • Building industry-first tools that help traders make better decisions

  • Building new types of rewards and incentives for traders

  • Whatever else you come up with to drive trading volume and grow the business

What you’ll need

  • 2–6 years’ experience in Product Management

  • A love of numbers – you think in probabilities and make data-driven decisions

  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal

  • Experience delivering amazing products to end customers

  • An entrepreneurial, high-ownership mindset

  • Comfort with basic trading concepts and familiar with top platforms like Kalshi, Polymarket, Robinhood, Coinbase and Hyperliquid.

  • You move fast

Nice to have

  • Experience in fintech  or building a trading product

  • A STEM background or quantitative degree

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - Stablecoins & Payments
jobs.description:
About Digital Asset & the Canton Network

Digital Asset builds the technologies that are reshaping the foundations of financial markets. Our mission is to create the world’s most trusted, privacy-enabled, and interoperable digital infrastructure for global finance.

At the heart of this mission is the Canton Network - the blockchain purpose-built for institutional finance. Uniquely combining privacy, compliance, and scalability, Canton enables real-time, secure settlement across multiple asset classes. Governed by the Canton Foundation with participation from leading financial institutions, it is the proven link between the promise of blockchain and the power of global finance.

Founded in 2014 and headquartered in New York City, with offices in London, Zurich, Budapest, Hong Kong, and Sydney— we are on a mission to transform finance— and that transformation is now playing out rapidly on the Canton Network.

If you’re interested in playing a crucial role at the intersection of traditional and crypto-capital markets and want to help bring the next trillion dollars of finance on-chain, join us.

About the role:

Canton Network is delivering what others promised but couldn’t: a blockchain for finance that actually works. As the only open layer 1 blockchain network with configurable privacy and controls sufficient for regulatory compliance, it is the venue where DeFi and TradFi are converging.

We are looking for a visionary Principal Product Manager to lead our Stablecoins & Onchain Payments product activation program. This is not just a "feature-owner" role, but rather you will be the architect of how stablecoins & payments move across the Canton Network.

As TradFi and DeFi converge, the demand for stable, regulatory-compliant and programmable units of value has never been higher. You will define and own the strategy for Digital Asset stablecoin & payments activation on the network, ensuring that stablecoin implementations and payment rails are not only technically superior but commercially dominant in contrast to other networks.

Responsibilities:

  • Identify and validate sustainable stablecoin and payment use cases on the Canton network, that can be activated together with institutional partners.
  • Define and execute the strategy and roadmap for stablecoins (fiat-backed, RWA-backed) and payments activation on the Canton Network, involving a cross-functional team of stakeholders and network participants (e.g. Tier 1 Stablecoin & RWA asset issuers). 
  • Work with institutional partners to design workflows that connect legacy payment & PoS systems with Canton’s privacy-enabled ledger.
  • Partner with Legal and Compliance teams to ensure payment initiatives meet global standards (e.g. MiCA, Basel III) while maintaining the privacy benefits of the Canton Network.
  • Ensure that the scaling of stablecoin and payment use cases focuses on high-availability, security and low-latency settlement.
  • Define and track Key Value Indicators (KVIs) for the use case activation on the network such as Mint/Burn volumes and Transaction Volume/Numbers.
  • Act as the primary product subject matter expert for stablecoins and payments use cases and activation within Digital Asset. 

What We're Looking For:

  • 7+ years of Product Management experience, with at least 3 years focused on stablecoins and payments .
  • Proven track record of shipping products related to stablecoins use case intersecting with aspects of treasury management, cross-border payments, PoS provision or automated clearing houses (ACH)
  • Deep understanding of the stablecoin and payments stack.
  • Understanding of blockchain technology  is required and it would be great to have a familiarity with payments focussed layer 1/2 ecosystems
  • While not a developer, you can confidently discuss application architecture, smart contract logic, and settlement workflows with engineers.
  • Experience building for B2B or B2B2C environments where security, compliance and "five-nines" reliability are non-negotiable.
  • You are comfortable discussing business models, pricing strategies and tokenomics. 
  • BIG BONUS: Direct experience with the Canton Network, Daml, or building institutional-grade Stablecoin payment applications.

Brookfield's global relationships, investment expertise and access to long-term institutional capital provide Radiant with a differentiated platform from which to develop, finance and operate AI infrastructure assets. This combination of entrepreneurial execution and institutional sponsorship enables Radiant to pursue large-scale GPU and AI infrastructure opportunities globally.
 Job Summary: 
 As a Senior Product Manager - Operations, you will own the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of Radiant’s internal tooling and integrations, helping teams operate and scale the cloud platform efficiently.
 You’ll work across CMDB, asset and service inventory, internal APIs, workflow automation, third-party integrations, and platform administration, partnering closely with engineering, SRE, infrastructure, networking, security, and operations.
 This is a highly technical product role focused on reducing operational friction, improving self-service, and creating reliable, scalable internal systems.

 Own the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of internal tooling, CMDB, service catalogues, operational workflows, and integrations.

 Translate business and operational needs into clear product requirements, specs, user stories, data models, and priorities.

 Partner with engineering to define solutions across APIs, integrations, automation, and platform tooling.

 Work with SRE, infrastructure, security, support, and other internal users to identify pain points and improve automation and self-service.

 Establish reliable sources of truth for infrastructure, services, customers, environments, ownership, and configuration.

 Drive prioritisation, backlog management, technical design discussions, delivery, and adoption.

 Define success metrics and ensure tooling is secure, observable, auditable, reliable, and well documented.

 Evaluate build vs. buy decisions and third-party tooling where appropriate.

 Qualifications: 
 Experience owning technical products, internal platforms, developer tooling, or infrastructure products end-to-end.

 Experience working across data centre operations, hardware lifecycle and inventory, infrastructure support, field operations, or adjacent operational environments.

 Strong technical fluency across:
 APIs & integrations: REST, gRPC, webhooks, third-party APIs

 Infrastructure: Kubernetes, cloud platforms, containers, infrastructure-as-code

 Data & CMDB: relational modelling, inventory, ownership, dependency mapping

 Automation: queues, schedulers, workflow engines, event-driven systems

 Observability & security: logging, metrics, tracing, IAM, RBAC, audit logging

 
 Familiarity with tools such as NetBox, ServiceNow, Terraform, Grafana, Jira, or similar.

 Strong understanding of distributed systems concepts including retries, idempotency, eventual consistency, and failure handling.

 Strong prioritisation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

 Comfortable working closely with engineers and making informed technical trade-offs without needing to be the primary implementer.

 Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment and taking ambiguous problems from discovery through to delivery.

 Systems thinking: Understand how infrastructure, services, data, and operational workflows fit together.

 Prioritisation: Balance operational pain, strategic value, technical complexity, and business impact.

About the team:

The Engagement tribe sits at the heart of SumUp's merchant experience, responsible for the product surfaces that 4.3 million business owners interact with every day, from the information they see about their business to the actions they take to grow it. As our Senior Product Manager, you'll own the merchant facing SuperApp end to end, a rare individual contributor role spanning product strategy, UX quality, and squad delivery, on the single surface the wider product organisation depends on to build and ship effectively. If you're looking for a role where your product decisions have a direct impact on how millions of businesses run and scale every day, this is it.

What you'll do:

  • Own the end to end product experience of our SuperApp across iOS, Android and web dashboard, raising the bar on UX quality, information architecture, and navigation for the surfaces merchants rely on most
  • Spot and execute activation, upsell, cross sell, and retention opportunities that measurably grow engagement and long term value for merchants
  • Shape the product strategy that makes the SuperApp an essential, everyday tool for small business owners running their business globally
  • Act as the main point of contact for stakeholders across the business who depend on the SuperApp to reach merchants, partnering closely with design and data on priorities
  • Build strong working relationships across engineering, design, and commercial teams, turning direct merchant insight into a clear, prioritised roadmap

You'll be great for this role if:

  • Track record leading a product squad end to end, from strategy through to shipped outcomes in engagement, retention, or monetisation
  • Strong technical or analytical foundation, whether from an engineering background or hands on experience as a data or business analyst, with the ability to think in systems and structure ambiguous problems
  • Comfort working fluently with both qualitative and quantitative data to inform decisions, rather than relying on others to surface the answer
  • Strong visual and UX judgement, with experience partnering closely with design and giving clear, constructive feedback
  • Ability to build a well reasoned product strategy independently, without needing a dedicated research or strategy function to get there
  • Experience advocating for merchants, with a track record of translating their everyday problems into practical product decisions

 🏙 Numerous other benefits such as Urban Sports Club subsidy, Kita placement assistance, subsidised office lunches

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager – Grant Projects (all genders)
jobs.description:
Your Mission: 
 As Senior Project Manager – Grant Projects (all genders), you will lead the delivery of our multi-year, large-scale EU-Innovation Fund project CAROLUS for the industrialisation of VÆRIDION's Microliner, including the set-up of our first Final Assembly Line at Oberpfaffenhofen Airport. Positioned within Programme Management and working closely with Finance, you will translate grant commitments into an integrated delivery plan and ensure that milestones, deliverables, and funding obligations are met on time, within budget, and in line with EU funding rules. You will coordinate activities across engineering, certification, operations, finance, and external partners, and act as the main point of contact for the funding authority. Depending on capacity, you will also support further EU and national grant projects, from proposal preparation through to day-to-day project management.
  
 Your Day-to-Day: 
 Lead our flagship industrialisation grant 
 Lead the end-to-end management of our CAROLUS grant project, from grant signature through industrialisation and entry into operation.

 Develop and maintain the integrated project plan, milestone schedule, and deliverable roadmap, aligned with the company's master schedule.

 Drive the completion of milestones and deliverables, ensuring that evidence is complete, consistent, and submitted on time.

 Establish and run project governance, including steering committee meetings, risk management, escalation, and change control processes.

 Coordinate engineering, certification, operations, and facility activities across internal teams and external stakeholders.

 Prepare periodic and annual reports, covering technical progress, emission reduction performance, and knowledge sharing.

 Act as the main point of contact for the funding authority, managing reporting obligations, communication, and grant amendments.

 Ensure compliance with funding, environmental, and visibility requirements, and maintain audit readiness throughout the project lifecycle.

 Support Our Grant Portfolio 
 Contribute to new EU and national funding proposals, including consortium building, work plans, and budgets

 Support grant agreement preparation and the kick-off of newly awarded projects

 Manage running grant projects, including reporting, payment requests, partner coordination, and documentation

  
 Your Profile: 
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.

 5+ years of project management experience.

 Proven track record of managing milestone-driven projects and reporting to senior management.

 Solid understanding of budgets, payment plans, and financial reporting.

 Experience in aerospace, industrial, or other highly regulated environments is a plus.

 Knowledge of lump sum EU funding or German national funding programmes is a plus.

 Experience with project management and planning tools such as Microsoft Project, Jira, Smartsheet, or similar.

 Highly structured and proactive, with strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

 Fluent in English; German is a plus.

 We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist. 
  
 Why us? 
 Be part of an ambitious team determined to shape the future of aviation.

 We are an in-office company, but we value flexibility and trust employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work or adjusting hours to accommodate personal commitments.

 Subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership: your (mental) health is important for us.

 Enjoy a subsidized lunch with a 5€ company contribution per meal on office days.

 Become a part of our success with virtual stock options.

 Choose the option that suits your needs: either a free charging station for your electric car or a public transport job ticket as part of the Deutschlandticket.

 Lease a high-quality bicycle or e-bike through our JobRad program and benefit from tax advantages. Whether for your daily commute or personal use, enjoy more mobility and sustainability.

 Pension scheme to support your long-term financial security.

 Work in one of our offices in Munich or Delft. Enjoy the modern Balan Campus in Munich or work inside the aerospace ecosystem at TU Delft.

 Boost your professional as well as personal growth executing your own ideas and independent projects.

 Join our internal social events and retreats (e.g. cooking, game nights, sports).

 VÆRIDION was founded in 2021 to transform regional air travel with the Microliner, a 100% electric commercial aircraft. By delivering the most energy-efficient aircraft, we are building the future where clean, safe, and affordable electric aviation seamlessly connects people and businesses. We’re bringing together the brightest minds in aerospace

jobs.title: AI Project Manager
jobs.description:
ParetoLabs is looking for an experienced and structured (Senior) AI Project Manager to lead AI projects for our clients from first idea to production.
 As part of our dynamic team, you will be the link between our clients, our engineers and the AI technologies we build with. You will scope projects, steer delivery and make sure what we ship creates real value in Swiss companies across a wide range of industries.
 About ParetoLabs 
 ParetoLabs is a Zurich-based software studio that develops customized, AI-powered applications for conversational and text-processing use cases. We help companies quickly test, implement, and scale AI applications within their specific business environments.
 Founded in 2023, ParetoLabs is a Microsoft for Startups partner that combines innovative AI technologies with the individual requirements of Swiss companies.
 Tasks
 Lead AI projects end to end — retrieval assistants, copilots and agents — from discovery and scoping to rollout and operation.
 Translate business problems into clear use cases, requirements and success criteria together with our clients.
 Plan and steer delivery with our engineering team: scope, timeline, budget, risks and priorities.
 Define how quality is measured and make sure solutions are evaluated before and after go-live.
 Work with client stakeholders on data, security, compliance and change management.
 Collaborate closely with our multicultural team and bring your own ideas to projects with real-world impact.
 Requirements
 Experience: Several years of project management in software, data or digital transformation projects; AI or data projects are a strong plus.
 AI Understanding: A solid grasp of how large language models, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and AI agents work, what they are good at and where they fail.
 Technical Foundation: Enough understanding of software architecture and cloud infrastructure (ideally Microsoft Azure) to discuss solutions with engineers and client IT and security teams.
 Methods: Confident with agile delivery and with structuring ambiguous problems into concrete plans.
 Stakeholder Management: Experience working with business and IT stakeholders up to management level, including managing expectations about what AI can and cannot do.
 Data & Compliance: Awareness of data protection (Swiss FADP, GDPR) and information security in client projects.
 Communication Skills: Excellent German and English, written and spoken.
 Mindset: Structured, hands-on and curious, with the ownership to bring projects over the finish line.
 Benefits
 Competitive Remuneration: A competitive salary package, reflecting your experience and contributions.
 Pick Your Gear: Choose your preferred devices for work.
 Attractive Benefits: above market pension benefits and a private accident insurance.
 Professional Growth: Participation in the Microsoft for Startups program, offering access to valuable resources, events and support.
 Interested in leading AI projects that make a real difference? We would be happy to hear from you.
 Please send us your CV and, if available, examples of projects you have led.
